description.short: Trusted macroeconomic data and intelligence from Macrobond, for AI assistants.
description.full: The Macrobond MCP connector gives AI assistants and coding environments direct access to trusted macroeconomic data, metadata, and search capabilities from Macrobond. Users can discover economic indicators, retrieve datasets using natural language, explore macroeconomic context, and integrate trusted macro intelligence directly into AI-powered workflows. Built on Macrobond's extensive database and knowledge layer, the connector helps organizations accelerate research, improve data discovery, and build AI solutions on a trusted macroeconomic foundation.
